column1: # operations.tsv - the operation table (SF-0 Sections 2, 6 item 2).
# One row per operation FAMILY; tools/gen_tables.py expands every family
# over tables/formats.tsv (and the integer width set of SF-0 Section 2.2)
# into instantiations. The expansion is the conformance surface: it is
# written out one row per instantiation in the generated coverage ledger
# are generated from the same expansion, so table, header, dispatch, and
# coverage cannot drift apart (drift check in tools/run.sh).
# Standard names and clause numbers are from IEEE 754-2019 as extracted
# by survey S1 (cited by clause only; no standard text is copied here).
#   op          API token (snake_case of the standard name); <int> expands
#   std_name    the 754-2019 operation name this family realises
#   sig         signature class driving code generation (gen_tables.py)
#   rounding    attr = takes msf_rounding_t; named = direction in the
#               operation name; none = not subject to rounding
#   flags       yes = takes msf_flags_t * (non-null, SF-0 Section 2.4);
#               state = 5.7.4 flag operation with its own fixed signature
#               over caller-owned state; no = never signals, no pointer
#   wave        earliest wave claiming the family (0=P0); instantiations
#   status      implemented = core provides it today; planned = declared,
#               dispatch reports it not-implemented by name
#   authority   deciding authority per SF-0 Section 4.3; auto-* expand
#               per instantiation by the rules in gen_tables.py
#   vectors     vector set name(s) gating the family
#   comparison  comparison rule the runner prints and applies;
#               bits and flags exact except that where invalid is
#               signaled the delivered integer follows the project rule
#               fixed in the header (saturation; NaN delivers zero),
